HOI4 IC — Bar Charts

One faction per line as Name: TAG, TAG, …. Edit to match your game (tags are the 3-letter codes), then Apply.

Load a HOI4 IC data log to begin.

Click Load .txt log… and pick a file from your
logging folder (e.g. tfu_0409.txt) or the HOI4 game folder.

All processing happens locally in your browser. Nothing is uploaded.

Snapshot Race — IC ranking on a single day

Drag the slider or press play to watch each country's IC rise and re-rank over the game. Values are the output rate on that day (IC / day), the same number the game shows — not a running total.

—

Final & Cumulative

Who won the IC race. Left: the output rate on the last logged day (IC / day). Right: the total IC produced over the whole game (every day's output summed) — a much larger number.

Yearly Snapshots

Same colour = same country across years.

Timeline — IC over the whole game

A line per country/faction across the entire game.

Line charts — monthly and produced IC

For each group, one chart of the IC produced per month and one of the running total produced. Uses the Metric selector at the top. A trailing partial month is left out of the monthly charts.

Faction definitions (Hearts of Oak 2)
One faction per line, NAME: TAG, TAG, .... Membership is fixed for the whole game, because the log does not record faction changes.

IC Calculator

The total equipment value of every nation in a save: stockpile, fielded units, fleets and assembly lines, plus combat losses and kills.

How it works
Load a .hoi4 save (plaintext or binary, binary is converted automatically; zipped ironman saves are not supported). Every item is priced from the selected mod's own equipment, module and upgrade definitions. Load a second save to see how each nation changed between the two.
